race.comment: BEAUMISTA (2) finds the right race today with the blinkers going on. Away only fairly when he stretched out to the 1250m for a battling ninth over 1250m at Newcastle. Proven at the trip from the good barrier and can score a long overdue victory. FEARN TRICK (10) kept the good first up record intact with a sharp on pace victory over 1100m at Wellington. Doesn't get the same map favours today but hard to ignore in this vein of form. Looks set for a good campaign. ANGIE'S SISTER (7) consistent mare who was three weeks between runs with a dominant 5.5 len win as fav over 900m at Wellington. Gets the gun run again and anticipating another big run. BOLO MISS (5) motored late with a respectable sixth in a Highway-C3 at Randwick over 1000m. Goes well here and look for her late from the wide gate.
